assumptions.cfr_prior: Triangular(0.20, 0.42, 0.68), informed by ECDC/Epiforecasts CFR range
assumptions.likelihood: overdispersed negative-binomial for deaths and exported cases

external_reference.source: ECDC overview of modelling evidence, 17 June 2026, summarising Epiforecasts estimate as of 13 June 2026
external_reference.note: External reference only; not directly used as the dashboard estimate.

interpretation_note: Reporting-adjusted estimate of infections, not confirmed cases. It depends on assumptions about reporting delay, CFR, and detection of exported cases in Uganda.
